data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'khazzarah', meaning a night illuminated by the moon. In Islamic culture, the moon symbolizes peace, guidance, and divine inspiration. The name Khazzarah carries the meaning “Moonlit night” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khazzarah usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlit night and live with faith, good character and purpose.
